questions.question: Find the sum of the first 10 terms of the arithmetic sequence 3, 7, 11, 15, ...
questions.explanation: First term a₁ = 3, common difference d = 4. 10th term: a₁₀ = 3 + (10-1)×4 = 3 + 36 = 39. Sum: S_n = n(a₁ + aₙ)/2 = 10(3 + 39)/2 = 10 × 42 / 2 = 210.

questions.question: What is the 5th term of the geometric sequence with first term 2 and common ratio 3?
questions.fastStrategy: Geometric term formula: aₙ = a₁ × r^(n-1).
